facts: Two main islands, Savaiʻi and Upolu
Two smaller inhabited islands, Manono and Apolima
worth_knowing: The archipelago has seen volcanic hotspot activity for the past 2 million years. Several smaller uninhabited islands, including the Aleipata Islands, lie off Upolu.
